aggressive.name: Offensive
aggressive.text: Each stack gets one action a turn: walk, shell, assault or grind (merge and split count too). An assault needs more strength (men + gear) than the defender's men + gear + terrain + trench chips + support, and costs the attacker men equal to the ground's terrain and trench chips (at least 1). The beaten stack retreats and the attacker advances; a defender with nowhere to go stands and loses 2 men. A failed or tied assault is not allowed: {points} points grind instead (each point costs both sides 1 man, nobody moves), or add to an assault to hurt the defender. The first attack is free, each further one costs {extraCost} point. A shooter next to its target can shell it: 1 point strips a trench chip, down to 1 chip; then {manCost} points take 1 man, never below 2 men; no loss to you.

J.name: Surprise
J.text: Trench chips do not count for the defender in assaults, in strength or in cost, and each point of shelling strips 2 chips.

Q.name: Combined arms
Q.text: Extra attacks are free and shelled men cost only 1 point.

K.name: No quarter
K.text: A beaten defender cannot retreat: it stands and loses 2 men.

A.name: Breakthrough
A.text: A beaten defender loses 1 more man.

defensive.name: Defence
defensive.text: {points} points: a trench chip (+1 defence, max {limit} per hex) on a stack.

J.name: Elastic defence
J.text: Your retreats are free until your next turn.

Q.name: Reserves
Q.text: Every stack facing the enemy gets a free trench chip.

K.name: Iron wall
K.text: +1 point, and trenches may be one deeper.

A.name: Hold the line
A.text: Elastic defence, a free chip on every stack facing the enemy, +1 point, deeper trenches.

reorganizational.name: Logistics
reorganizational.text: {points} points: rail +{railHexes} hexes of movement on home soil, ignoring terrain stops, once per stack (1), rally +1 gear up to {limit} (2), merge adjacent stacks (1), split a stack (1).

K.name: Depots
K.text: Rallying costs 1 and may go one higher.

willingness.name: Home Front
willingness.text: {points} points: relief -{relief} exhaustion (1), recruit +1 man in a home stack (2).
